claims.statement: W. E. Harding, sporting editor of the Police Gazette, said Tom Allen was spoiling for a fight with Sullivan.
claims.excerpt:
Allen, 1 think, is spoilin
for a fight with Sullivan.

claims.statement: W. E. Harding said that when the Police Gazette brought Tom Allen out from Boston he was a wreck (printed as "tot wreck").
claims.excerpt:
When we brough
Tom Allen out from Boston he was a tot
wreck

quotes.speaker: W. E. Harding
quotes.text:
This Tom Alien fuss i
all wind and nothing more.

notes: Harding's dismissal of Allen as a contender; no bout by Allen in the text. Hint called the Sullivan remark a challenge; it is an opinion, not a match. Date of the interview not given.
